request.subject: CURIOSITY:WRECK

layers.text: Sink the ship halfway: erase everything below one straight horizontal line through the middle of the hull, so only the upper half of the hull, the mast and the torn sail remain, ending in a flat straight bottom edge with a thin line of white foam along it. Keep the upper hull, the mast, the cream sail, the outline and the art style exactly the same; transparent background.
